pos.personaBrief: France under Deschamps ceded the ball and countered through Mbappe (Halfspaces 2022, Guardian 2018 with Belgium at 64 percent, theScore 18th in possession); he calls sterile possession pointless.

pro.personaBrief: Quick vertical transitions to Mbappe and Pogba long balls, safe 3+1 cover behind the ball and a pragmatic style rather than patient build-up.

est.personaBrief: Players given singular tasks and fixed roles in a stable base shape (theScore 2018, MBP 2022), wide players kept on the flanks, crowd in the central channel.

lar.personaBrief: MBP says he accumulates players in the central channel, with width from full-backs and wing-backs, and an extra midfielder such as Matuidi on the left in 2018.

blo.personaBrief: Mid or low block, little pressing, no front-three press in 2021, and his own view that it is better to drop off than stay in between.

mar.personaBrief: Compact block protecting space; 2016 evidence implies individual marking at set pieces, and the 2018 plan targeted opponents' aerial threats.

pla.personaBrief: Adapts system to the available players and the opponent (4-3-3 versus 5-2-1-2, 2018 Uruguay set-piece adjustment, 2021 half-time switch to a back four) while keeping the same principles.

res.personaBrief: Arch-pragmatist: tournaments are won by the most efficient sides, not the most entertaining; low block once ahead, 1-0 over Belgium.

sis.personaBrief: Built the team in his own image with singular tasks, flair players like Pogba asked to take on defensive duties, system and balance over individual freedom.

jog.personaBrief: Physically imposing midfield by design (Bleacher Report, MBP), athletic two-man midfield, pace of Mbappe, set pieces and duels.

bas.personaBrief: Loyal to proven players and chosen men, picks on fit and experience, though he debuted many players (78 by 2024) and fielded a young 2018 squad; goal is winning, not development.

lid.personaBrief: High standards and rigour, excluded Benzema and Rabiot when trust broke, selects for group fit; the coach decides, stars follow the same rules.
